arxiv-1805-03330.title: Character-level Chinese-English Translation through ASCII Encoding
arxiv-1805-03330.creator: Nikola I. Nikolov, Yuhuang Hu, Mi Xue Tan, Richard H.R. HahnloserInstitute of Neuroinformatics, University of Zürich and ETH Zürich, Switzerland {niniko, yuhuang.hu, mtan, rich}@ini.ethz.ch
arxiv-1805-03330.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Nikola I. Nikolov, Yuhuang Hu, Mi Xue Tan, Richard H.R. HahnloserInstitute of Neuroinformatics, University of Zürich and ETH Zürich, Switzerland {niniko, yuhuang.hu, mtan, rich}@ini.ethz.ch. Character-level Neural Machine Translation (NMT) models have recently achieved impressive results on many language pairs. They mainly do well for Indo-European language pairs, where the languages share the same writing system.

arxiv-1905-11893.title: BreizhCrops: A Time Series Dataset for Crop Type Mapping
arxiv-1905-11893.creator: Marc Rußwurm 1, Charlotte Pelletier 2, Maximilian Zollner 1, Sébastien Lefèvre 2, Marco Körner 1
arxiv-1905-11893.description: Abstract We present BreizhCrops , a novel benchmark dataset for the supervised classification of field crops from satellite time series. We aggregated label data and Sentinel-2 top-of-atmosphere as well as bottom-of-atmosphere time series in the region of Brittany (Breizh in local language), north-east France. We compare seven recently proposed deep neural networks along with a Random Forest baseline.

arxiv-2205-10250.title: Explanatory machine learning for sequential human teaching Journal: Machine learning
arxiv-2205-10250.creator: Lun Ai, Johannes Langer, Stephen H. Muggleton, Ute Schmid
arxiv-2205-10250.description: Abstract The topic of comprehensibility of machine-learned theories has recently drawn increasing attention. Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) uses logic programming to derive logic theories from small data based on abduction and induction techniques. Learned theories are represented in the form of rules as declarative descriptions of obtained knowledge.

arxiv-2310-20221.title: Cayley Linear–Time Computable Groups
arxiv-2310-20221.creator: Prohrak Kruengthomya, Dmitry Berdinsky
arxiv-2310-20221.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Prohrak Kruengthomya, Dmitry Berdinsky. Abstract This paper looks at the class of groups admitting normal forms for which the right multiplication by a group element is computed in linear time on a multi–tape Turing machine. We show that the groups \mathbb{Z}_{2}\wr\mathbb{Z}^{2} , \mathbb{Z}_{2}\wr\mathbb{F}_{2} and Thompson’s group F have normal forms for which the right multiplication by a group element is computed in linear time on a 2 –tape Turing machine.

arxiv-2503-02678.title: Smart Reaction Templating: A Graph-Based Method for Automated Molecular Dynamics Input Generation
arxiv-2503-02678.creator: Julian Konrad, Robert Meißner
arxiv-2503-02678.description: Abstract Abstract Accurately modeling chemical reactions in molecular dynamics simulations requires detailed pre- and post-reaction templates, often created through labor-intensive manual workflows. This work introduces a Python-based algorithm that automates the generation of reaction templates for the LAMMPS REACTION package, leveraging graph-theoretical principles and sub-graph isomorphism techniques.

arxiv-2503-23491.title: POINT 2 : A Polymer Informatics Training and Testing Database
arxiv-2503-23491.creator: Jiaxin Xu, Gang Liu, Ruilan Guo, Meng Jiang, Tengfei Luo*
arxiv-2503-23491.description: Abstract The advancement of polymer informatics has been significantly propelled by the integration of machine learning (ML) techniques, enabling the rapid prediction of polymer properties and expediting the discovery of high-performance polymeric materials. However, the field lacks a standardized workflow that encompasses prediction accuracy, uncertainty quantification, ML interpretability, and polymer synthesizability.

arxiv-2504-15826.title: Full waveform inversion with CNN-based velocity representation extension
arxiv-2504-15826.creator: Xinru Mu, Omar M. Saad, Tariq Alkhalifah
arxiv-2504-15826.description: Abstract Full waveform inversion (FWI) updates the velocity model by minimizing the discrepancy between observed and simulated data. However, discretization errors in numerical modeling and incomplete seismic data acquisition can introduce noise, which propagates through the adjoint operator and affects the accuracy of the velocity gradient, thereby impacting the FWI inversion accuracy.

arxiv-2509-22674.title: Pathological Truth Bias in Vision–Language Models
arxiv-2509-22674.creator: Yash Thube
arxiv-2509-22674.description: Abstract Vision–Language Models (VLMs) are improving rapidly, but standard benchmarks miss systematic failures nguyen2025biased ; wang2024spatial ; yuksekgonul2023bags that harm real-world trust. We study pathological truth bias sharma2023sycophancy ; perez2022discovering : the tendency of VLMs to agree with patently false, visually absurd statements.

britannica-1911-falk-paul-ludwig-adalber.title: Falk, Paul Ludwig Adalbert (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-falk-paul-ludwig-adalber.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-falk-paul-ludwig-adalber.description: Article 'Falk, Paul Ludwig Adalbert' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. politician, was born at Matschkau, Silesia, on the 10th of August 1827. In 1847 he entered the Prussian state service, and in 1853 became public prosecutor at Lyck. In 1858 he was elected a deputy, joining the Old Liberal party. In 1868 he became a privy-councillor in the ministry of justice.

pmc-10629079.title: Development and validation of the ADHD Symptom and Side Effect Tracking - Baseline Scale (ASSET-BS): a novel short screening measure for ADHD in clinical populations
pmc-10629079.creator: Joel L. Young, Richard N. Powell, Celeste Zabel, Jaime Saal, Lisa L. M. Welling, Jillian Fortain, Ashley Ceresnie
pmc-10629079.description: ObjectiveThe aim was to develop and test a novel screen of adult ADHD, with a specific focus on clinical use. We designed a series of three studies to accomplish this aim.MethodStudy One (n = 155) and Study Two (n = 591) collected data via surveys to conduct exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses, respectively.

pmc-11476285.title: The Potential Role of SNRPD1 Stabilized by IGF2BP2 in the Progression of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
pmc-11476285.creator: Siqi Liu, Xin Sun, Na Liu, Fangcai Lin
pmc-11476285.description: BackgroundInsulin-like growth factor 2 mRNA-binding protein 2 (IGF2BP2), an RNA-binding protein with N6-methyladenosine (m6A) reader function, is associated with the poor prognosis of various tumors, including triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). Small nuclear ribonucleoprotein D1 polypeptide (SNRPD1), a spliceosome member, exerts diagnostic and therapeutic functions in breast cancer by regulating the cell cycle and is a potential therapeutic target.

pmc-11495325.title: The conundrum of the giant condyloma: is it carcinoma?
pmc-11495325.creator: Hyung C Kim, James D Schlenker, Amber B Post, Nicholas S Agoff, Timothy Feldmann, Vlad V Simianu
pmc-11495325.description: Perineal verrucous carcinoma is a rare variant of squamous cell carcinoma that is mainly treated with surgical excision. In this case report, we present a 58-year-old man with human immunodeficiency virus who presented with an extraordinarily large perineal mass that was ultimately found to be verrucous carcinoma in association with giant condyloma acuminata.

pmc-11707877.title: The transcription factor ORA59 represses hypoxia responses during Botrytis cinerea infection and reoxygenation
pmc-11707877.creator: Luca Brunello, Alicja B Kunkowska, Emma Olmi, Paolo M Triozzi, Simone Castellana, Pierdomenico Perata, Elena Loreti
pmc-11707877.description: Transcription factors belonging to the large ethylene response factor (ERF) family are involved in plant responses to biotic and abiotic stresses. Among the ERFs, OCTADECANOID-RESPONSIVE ARABIDOPSIS 59 (ORA59) integrates ethylene and jasmonic acid signaling to regulate resistance to necrotrophic pathogens.

pmc-12408647.title: Integrative scRNA-seq and transcriptomic analysis initially reveals monocyte/macrophage activation drives EV-A71-induced immune dysregulation and neural injury in severe HFMD
pmc-12408647.creator: Muqi Wang, Meng Zhang, Huiling Deng, Yufeng Zhang, Chenrui Liu, Yuan Chen, Chuting Zhang, Wen Zhang, Xiaoli Jia, Shuangsuo Dang, Yaping Li
pmc-12408647.description: ObjectiveEnterovirus 71 (EV-A71) is a major pathogen of severe hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) in children, but the mechanism by which it develops into severe HFMD remains unclear, especially the role of macrophage-mediated immune dysregulation.MethodsBioinformatics tools were utilized to analyze the transcriptome sequencing results of peripheral blood monocytes (PBMCs) infected with different titers of EV-A71 at various time points.

pmc-12567607.title: An Integrated Experimental System for Unmanned Underwater Vehicle Swarm Control
pmc-12567607.creator: Yutao Chen, Xingwei Zhou, Wenshan Hu, Bo Zhao, Enrico Meli
pmc-12567607.description: Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV) swarms have become increasingly crucial for underwater exploration and applications, where their coordinated operation offers significant advantages over single-vehicle systems. However, unlike single-vehicle systems, the development of swarm control systems is more complicated, especially because there are limited integrated toolchains that can cover both global scheme design and individual vehicle implementation.

pmc-12590797.title: The application and effectiveness of PBL combined with MDT and flipped classroom teaching method in acute coronary syndrome education for undergraduate medical students
pmc-12590797.creator: Yuhui Lin, Xiaoqing He, Wenjun Dai, Wenpeng Tan, Yunhong Xu
pmc-12590797.description: BackgroundThe development of medical education is rapidly evolving, with innovative teaching methods such as problem-based learning (PBL) and multidisciplinary treatment (MDT) combined with flipped classroom approaches gaining increasing attention in clinical medical education. However, the actual effectiveness of PBL combined with MDT and flipped classroom methods in the teaching of cardiovascular diseases has not been well studied.

pmc-12671339.title: Autonomic neuropathy in diabetes
pmc-12671339.creator: Lucianne Righeti Monteiro Tannus, Roberta Arnoldi Cobas
pmc-12671339.description: Diabetic autonomic neuropathy (DAN) is a serious and often under-recognized complication of diabetes that can affect any division of the autonomic nervous system (ANS), presenting with a wide range of signs and symptoms. The pathophysiology of DAN involves a complex interplay of hyperglycemia-driven metabolic and vascular pathways, oxidative stress, inflammation, and autonomic imbalance, ultimately leading to progressive nerve dysfunction.

pmc-12743795.title: Benefits and Challenges When Implementing Incremental Hemodialysis: A Qualitative Study of Patients and Providers
pmc-12743795.creator: Noémie Laurier, Chloe Wong-Mersereau, Shaifali Sandal, Antoine Przybylak-Brouillard, Ali Taha, Alexander Messina, Daniel Blum, Catherine Weber, Emilie Trinh
pmc-12743795.description: Background:In 2022, we implemented an incremental hemodialysis (iHD) protocol to initiate twice-weekly treatment for eligible patients. This patient-centered approach aims to ease the transition to dialysis and enhance quality of life. However, limited data exists on how iHD is experienced by patients and health care providers (HCPs).

pmc-13008835.title: Paradigm shifts in mental health legislation: a comparative analysis of WHO guidelines (2006 & 2023) and implications for future policies
pmc-13008835.creator: Qian Xue, Bo Chen
pmc-13008835.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study presents a comparative analysis of the World Health Organization’s mental health legislative guidance spanning nearly two decades, documenting a fundamental paradigm shift that reflects broader transformations in psychiatric research and practice. By systematically examining the WHO’s Resource Book on Mental Health, Human Rights and Legislation (2006) and the Mental health, human rights and legislation: guidance and practice: Guidance and Practice (2023), we illuminate how the UN CRPD has reconceptualized mental health law.

pmc-13194486.title: Virtual reality-based inhibition training influences food-related responses: no additional effects of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation
pmc-13194486.creator: Hyeong Ha Kim, HeungSik Yoon, Sang Hee Kim
pmc-13194486.description: Combining cognitive inhibition training with brain stimulation techniques has received increasing attention as a potential approach to modulating maladaptive food craving and food intake. Building on previous work in this line of research, the current study examined whether virtual reality (VR)-based no-go inhibition training paired with repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) modulates implicit food-related attitudes, craving and food-choice behaviors.

pmc-13214234.title: Standalone interspinous process devices for lumbar spinal stenosis: a critical literature review
pmc-13214234.creator: Jimmy Wen, Shannon Dwyer, Megan Kou, Yu-Tung Chen, Allyson Kouche, Sugamjot Badhan, Arsh Alam, Naomi Pai, Megan Diana Hsu, Jose Silva, Foad Elahi
pmc-13214234.description: BackgroundInterspinous process devices (IPDs) have been widely promoted as a minimally invasive alternative to traditional decompressive surgery for lumbar spinal stenosis (LSS). However, their clinical durability, safety, and comparative effectiveness have remained controversial. This review aims to review and synthesize the biomechanical rationale, clinical outcomes, safety profile, and limitations of IPDs for the treatment of LSS.

pmc-13245395.title: A cohort study of the duration of immunity to yellow fever after 4 years of primary vaccination in children and adults
pmc-13245395.creator: Camylla Veloso Valença Saucha, Raquel de Vasconcellos Carvalhaes de Oliveira, Maria de Lourdes de Sousa Maia, Eduardo Sérgio Soares Sousa, Patrícia Mouta Nunes de Oliveira, Janaína Reis Xavier, Thalita da Matta de Castro, Robson Leite de Souza Cruz, Waleska Dias Schwarcz, Renata Carvalho Pereira, Ad
pmc-13245395.description: BackgroundLifelong protective immunity from a single dose of yellow fever (YF) vaccine remains controversial. We evaluated variations in YF neutralizing antibody titres over 4 years after primary vaccination.MethodsA cohort study was conducted in three municipalities in northeastern Brazil. The 17DD vaccine was administered between 2016 and 2018.

pmc-13310387.creator: Ethel S Shang, Clovis Nkoke, Julius Nwobegahay, Charles Njumkeng, Betrand A Tambe, Malik Suliman Mohamed
pmc-13310387.description: BackgroundAdherence to antiretroviral therapy (ART) is an essential component in the global response to HIV/AIDS. Despite increased access to ART in Cameroon, maintaining adherence to ART remains a significant challenge, jeopardising progress toward the global 95‐95‐95 HIV treatment targets.ObjectivesTo assess the level of adherence to ART and associated factors among people living with HIV at Yaounde Military Hospital in Cameroon.

pmc-13670269.description: ContextBMSC senescence is associated with osteoporosis progression. Polygonatum sibiricum polysaccharide (PSP) shows potential anti-senescence activity, but its effects on bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) remain unclear.ObjectiveTo investigate the protective effects and molecular mechanisms of PSP against tert-butyl hydroperoxide (TBH)-induced senescence in BMSCs.Materials and methodsSenescence was induced in primary rat BMSCs with TBH, followed by PSP intervention.
